svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: Loaded controls and runtime semantic coverage are frozen separately in CONTROL.json (SHA256 32aaaee29003ed718863467567aa91185fc794b9019abcf5abe20e242511de0c). One independent persistent client runs eval return 1 on existing worker-0 every 100 ms while measured workers execute. Missed cadence slots are skipped. Probe latency includes same-tab serialization and, in the secondary experiment, common admission waiting. In-flight probe completion remains in active wall time, CPU and footprint. Raw schedule/start/end timestamps and counts are retained. Loaded-control p95 has its own <=1.10 comparison gate; idle socket/CLI probes retain separate labels and cannot prove the loaded-control gate.
